note: Issue #95: what the mechanic in the desert sells for a speeder. Read by src/systems/vehicles/speeder_upgrades.gd (prices, rules, stats) and src/systems/world/speeder_shop.gd (the shop, its words). Issue #295: 'mechanic' is Dorrin's shop; 'shops' holds the others (Skrugs's garage bench, free roam only; Torrin and Jorrin, Dorrin's cousins, at the basin and salt crews' stalls: content/core/locations/speeder_stall.json, placed by a crew file's 'shop' block, each with an 'outfit' for the shopkeeper), each laid over Dorrin's block (SpeederUpgrades.shop), so the menu, parts and prices are the same and only the name, bay and words change. A part has a slot; a speeder holds one part per slot, except 'paint', which can be bought again. 'requires' is the part before it in its line (tier 2 needs tier 1, and replaces it). 'mods' multiply the speeder's numbers in content/core/vehicles/speeder.json ('laser.damage' reaches into the laser). 'hover' turns on the Grav Lifter in hover_model.gd. Looks-only parts change nothing but the look. Scrap pays 'base' plus 'parts_back' of what was spent on parts. Issue #627: a part with a 'model' fits only that vehicle (content/core/vehicles/<model>.json; none = the Sand-boxer), and a vehicle's 'shop_groups' limit the menu (the racer and the box truck: paint only); a vehicle's 'scrap_base' replaces 'base'. Issue #615: a part's `unlocked_by` names a race crew (content/core/racing/crews/): in story mode it is for sale only once you have beaten them, and the menu says whose leader to beat; in free roam everything is for sale. Issue #616: race gear (group "race"): seekers, mines and a deflector carry a `gear` block (SpeederGear: load, refill, damage, lock cone and range; a mine's blast is the grenade's keys); nitro tiers are plain mods on boost_time and boost_recharge. Speeder classes: `shared_groups` are the groups whose parts (with no 'model') fit every vehicle, so the racer and the box truck take the same engines, thrusters, cannons, race gear and Grav Lifter as the Sand-boxer; looks stay the Sand-boxer's, and each model's paint parts carry its 'model' (issue #628: the racer's and the box truck's are recolours of their own Hyper3D bodies, look.paints in their vehicle files). A mod on a number the vehicle does not have (an engine's boost_speed on the box truck, which drifts) does nothing. A part's optional 'look' is what it bolts on, so a part you buy shows on the speeder: pieces in the vehicle files' stand-in piece format (box or cyl, 'mat' plate, dark, trim or glow) placed at one of the vehicle's look.mounts (hood, rack, tanks, dome, flank, tail, each an 'at' and an optional 'tilt'; 'muzzle' is laser.muzzle and 'belly' the underside), built by SpeederNode._build_fit_looks; 'mirror' copies a piece across the speeder's centre line. Kept small and in the speeder's own metal and trim. Balance: a laser bolt is 15% of a Sand-boxer, a seeker (hit and splash) or a mine a third, so three of either wreck one; the racer has half its health and the box truck three times.

mechanic.name: Dorrin Vask
mechanic.speeders_note: Dorrin sells every model Skrugs does (Skrugs's card's sale.models: the same ids and prices), one of each to a customer whoever sold it (SpeederPost.at_limit). A speeder he sells waits in the row outside the town's back gate, like every new speeder (SpeederPost.line_spot). Skrugs's bench in free roam does not (shops.skrugs).

lines.too_poor: Come back when your credits can pay for it.
lines.scrapped: Pleasure doing business. She'll make good spares.
